results.title: England at the 2026 World Cup: Squad, Tactics, Key Players & Group L Guide | Fanorate
highlights:
England are fascinating in 2026 for the tension between abundance and execution. No nation has a deeper pool of attacking talent, yet England have repeatedly fallen short of converting it into silverware. Tuchel’s appointment adds intrigue: a foreign, tactically demanding coach taking on the country that invented the game, charged with finally turning potential into a trophy.

[...]
England are among the genuine favourites. With a top-five FIFA ranking and a favourable-looking Group L draw, they should be expected to top the group. England open against Croatia — comfortably their toughest group test — before facing Ghana and Panama.
[...]
Realistically, anything short of the semi-finals would be viewed as underachievement at home, and many supporters will accept nothing less than the final. The expanded 48-team format means a longer road, but England’s depth is built for tournament attrition.
[...]
Under Tuchel, England are expected to be more structured and proactive than in recent cycles. Expect a back four built on John Stones’ composure, Rice screening in front, and Bellingham given license to drive into the final third. The wide forwards — Saka and Gordon/Madueke — provide width and one-v-one threat, while Kane links play between the lines. Tuchel favours intelligent pressing triggers and positional discipline; the key tactical challenge will be unlocking deep defensive blocks, a recurring England problem.
[...]
- Star power — Bellingham, Saka and Kane are box-office attractions in full flow.
- The Tuchel experiment — a demanding foreign coach trying to crack England’s trophy curse is compelling theatre.
- Drama guaranteed — England rarely do anything the easy way; expect tension, especially if it goes to penalties.
- A heavyweight opener — England vs Croatia revives memories of the 2018 semi-final.
[...]
Deep knockout run — semi-final or better, with a genuine chance of reaching the final.
[...]
England should win Group L, with the Croatia game the likely decider for top spot. Given the squad depth and a manageable early path, a run to at least the semi-finals is the reasonable expectation, with a genuine chance of reaching the final. Whether they can finally win a knockout shootout or break down an elite opponent will determine if 2026 ends in glory or familiar frustration. Projected: deep knockout run, semi-final or better.

results.title: Netherlands at FIFA World Cup 2026: Oranje Squad, Koeman's Vision and Group F Preview | Fanorate
highlights:
Netherlands World Cup 2026 guide: Koeman’s squad, Van Dijk’s leadership, key players, tactics, Group F outlook and our prediction for the three-time finalists.
[...]
The Netherlands carry a romance unmatched by most contenders: a footballing identity rooted in attacking philosophy yet shadowed by decades of near-misses. With a captain in Virgil van Dijk widely regarded as one of the finest defenders of his era, a midfield orchestrated by Frenkie de Jong, and an attack with genuine Premier League firepower, this is a team capable of going deep. The question that always hovers over Oranje — can they finally convert quality into a trophy? — makes every tournament compelling.
[...]
## Expected to win Group F comfortably — and realistic quarter-final or semi-final contenders.
[...]
As a top-10 FIFA-ranked side, the Netherlands are expected to win Group F comfortably and are realistic quarter-final or semi-final contenders. They open against Japan on June 14 — a tricky test against a fast, technical opponent — before facing Sweden and Tunisia. Anything short of the knockout rounds would be a disappointment.
[...]
A deep run to the semi-finals or final would feel like vindication for a golden generation. Koeman’s challenge is managing expectation against the historical weight of three lost finals.
[...]
## Structured 4-3-3 or 4-2-3-1 — Dutch attacking instincts with Koeman’s defensive discipline.
[...]
Koeman typically favours a structured 4-3-3 or 4-2-3-1 that retains Dutch attacking instincts while adding defensive solidity. Build-up runs through Van Dijk and De Jong, with full-backs (notably Dumfries) providing width and overlapping runs. The front line presses selectively and looks to exploit pace in transition. Expect controlled possession against weaker opponents and a more pragmatic, counter-ready setup against elite sides.

Whether they can finally exorcise the ghosts of three lost finals depends on Koeman’s big-match management and the fitness of his key players.

results.title: England World Cup 2026 team preview: Players to watch, group and squad list | World Cup 2026 News | Al Jazeera
highlights:
It has now been 60 years of hurt for England, who lifted their only World Cup title in 1966. But while the Three Lions are certainly genuine contenders this time around, they come into the 2026 edition in a rather unsettled mood.
[...]
However, it’s fair to say that it was not the toughest group, and their performances in recent friendlies have drawn boos from fairly unenthused Wembley crowds, not least the defeats to Senegal and Japan.
[...]
Can England get a tune out of the likes of Jude Bellingham and Harry Kane? Can the Three Lions find a way back to playing entertaining football? And does coach Thomas Tuchel actually know his best team?
[...]
In addition to contending with this record, the former Chelsea and PSG boss Tuchel has also faced criticism over the failure to improve England’s style of play, which is still often marred by slow, sideways passes.
[...]
And while it’s logical to experiment, it’s also not clear he really knows his best team, and attempts to play a false nine or two number 10s have not come off.
[...]
Nevertheless, there’s no doubt that Tuchel is an elite manager and his solid, well-organised England side won their group with a 100 percent record (eight wins from eight), including tough wins away at Serbia and Albania, and conceded zero goals in the process.
[...]
Despite winning the golden boot at the
[...]
2018 World Cup, England have often failed to get the best out of their captain and record goalscorer at major tournaments.
[...]
However, if England can field a relatively fresh Kane in North America, the 33-year-old should be high on confidence following his best-ever season in front of goal.
[...]
England’s captain also has his country’s World Cup scoring record in sight as he needs just two more strikes to equal Gary Lineker’s record of 10 goals in the tournament.
[...]
Bellingham is perhaps the most effective out of several talented England number 10s, but the 22-year-old has had a frustrating club season as he has contended with injuries and his side’s frequently poor form, and accordingly, his England appearances have also been sporadic recently.
[...]
Aston Villa’s Morgan Rogers may have staked a strong claim to start ahead of him based on appearances under Tuchel and his sparkling club form.
[...]
Group L contains some tricky opponents, and England face a particularly tough opener against 11th-ranked Croatia, who beat England in the 2018 semifinal.
[...]
And while 74th-ranked Ghana are the four-seeded underdogs, they could also pose a stiff test as they boast the likes of Antoine Semenyo and Mohammed Kudus.
[...]
## Al Jazeera’s prediction
[...]
Quarterfinals.
[...]
Is it coming home? Probably not, but England still expects.

results.title: England vs. Netherlands head to head record, history, results, past games ahead of Euro 2024 semifinal | Sporting News Canada
highlights:
England vs. Netherlands head to head record, history, results, past games ahead of Euro 2024 semifinal | Sporting News Canada
[...]
# England vs. Netherlands head to head record, history, results, past games ahead of Euro 2024 semifinal
[...]
England take on the Netherlands in the semifinals of Euro 2024 with the Three Lions still aiming for a first title since 1966.
[...]
Gareth Southgate's team have battled through to the final four following a quarterfinal penalty shootout win over Switzerland in the previous round.
[...]
The Netherlands have improved as the tournament has progressed, after a mixed showing in the group stages, and they rallied to knock out Turkey in the quarters.
[...]
A showdown in Dortmund is a huge clash for both sides and historical meetings between the two teams has thrown up some superb battles.
[...]
## England vs. Netherlands head to head record, history, results
[...]
| England wins | Draws | Netherlands wins |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 6 | 9 | 7 |
[...]
England and the Netherlands have faced each other 22 times since their first meeting 1935. That has included two meetings in the UEFA European Championships and once in the FIFA World Cup.
[...]
The overall record stands at six wins for England, compared to seven for the Netherlands, with nine draws.
[...]
Following eight friendly meetings, in which England won four times, the first competitive clash came at Euro '88. Dutch icon Marco van Basten netted a superb hat-trick to secure 3-1 win in Dusseldorf.
[...]
England were knocked out in the group stages as La Oranje went on to win the final against the Soviet Union and Van Basten netted one of the finest goals the competition has ever seen.
[...]
They met again in the group stages of the 1990 World Cup in Italy, and could not be split in a 0-0 draw, as England lost out to eventual champions West Germany in the semifinals.
[...]
The Dutch then ended England's chance of qualifying for the 1994 World Cup before the Three Lions secured some revenge as hosts of Euro '96.
[...]
Two goals each from Alan Shearer and Teddy Sheringham propelled England out of the group stages before again losing out on penalties to Germany in a semifinal.
[...]
Since 1996, England have won just once in nine meetings with the Netherlands, including a 3-1 defeat in the 2019 UEFA Nations League semifinals
[...]
